task: The test suite of this repository fails. Run `pytest -q` to see which tests fail and why. Find the defect in the source that makes them fail and fix it, so that the same command passes. Do not edit, delete, skip or weaken any test: the tests are the specification, and a change to them is not a fix. If you cannot find the defect, leave the tree as it is and reply NOT-DONE with what you checked and what you ruled out.
